title: SESSION-CLOSE-2: run the session reaper on every heartbeat tick
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** SESSION-CLOSE-1 merged
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/tick.js::foundation sessions
**Status:** closed

Wire `python3 -m foundation sessions --apply` into the tick (seed/worker/src/tick.js via the executor dispatch) and a daily workflow with the budget headers, so a ledger line exists per tick. First run will park the 19 branches idle past 4 h on 2026-11-12. Closing probe: `ops/session-ledger.jsonl` gains a line per tick and `sessions --scan` reports 0 zombies.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 221.7 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
